rubrics.justification: It correctly states that no image was provided and avoids inventing morphological features or a Gardner grade.
It integrates age, BMI, FSH, diagnosis, sperm quality, endometrium, prior IVF outcomes, and lifestyle well, though some assumptions about embryo quality are necessarily speculative.
The reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to stated assumptions; minor overreach comes from assuming a good-quality blastocyst despite absent morphology.
Most recommendations are broadly evidence-based, but strong endorsement of PGT-A, ERA/EMMA/ALICE, and immunologic workup is more aggressive than guideline-supported routine practice in this profile.
It provides clear next steps for transfer review, luteal support, transfer technique, and future evaluation, though some suggestions are somewhat generic and contingent on missing embryo data.
